say:3:1826044001:1.text: You must be Miss Senea. I must say, you're every bit as elegant and charming as I've heard. No wonder you have so many fans.
say:3:1826044001:1.source_cn: 想必你一定就是塞涅小姐。果然和传闻中一样，优雅动人，令...

say:4:1826044002:0.text: A pleasure to meet you. Are you a guest of Lady Tephesia?
say:4:1826044002:0.source_cn: 你好。你是领主阁下的客人？

say:5:1826044003:1.text:
I'm Viscount Salazer.
It's a delight to make your acquaintance, Miss Senea.
say:5:1826044003:1.source_cn: ——斯莱泽子爵。\n很高兴认识你，塞涅小姐。

say:6:1826044004:1.text: Viscount... So you're one of Bantus' undead.
say:6:1826044004:1.source_cn: 子爵……那么，你是班题斯的亡灵。

say:7:1826044005:1.text: Allow me to remind you, Miss Senea, that you are one of Bantus' undead now as well.
say:7:1826044005:1.source_cn: 请容我提醒你，塞涅小姐，你现在也是班题斯的亡灵。

say:8:1826044006:1.text: I'd heard that you and Lady Tephesia were quite close, and that she never missed a performance. Yet... these VIP seats are covered in dust. <style="highlight">When was the last time she attended a show</style>?
say:8:1826044006:1.source_cn: 听闻苔佩希小姐与你素来要好，你的每场演出她必定到场。但...

say:9:1826044007:1.text: We haven't had a show in a while, so the cleaning's fallen behind.
say:9:1826044007:1.source_cn: 最近海歌剧院没有演出安排，只是疏于打扫。

say:10:1826044008:1.text: Thank you for bringing that to my attention. I'll have the cushions and tablecloths in the VIP section replaced before my next show.
say:10:1826044008:1.source_cn: 感谢你的提醒。下次演出前，我会请工作人员为贵宾席更换坐...

say:11:1826044009:1.text: That's the right thing to do. You certainly wouldn't want to get on Lady Tephesia's bad side.
say:11:1826044009:1.source_cn: 当然，当然。你们可不能怠慢了尊贵的苔佩希小姐。

say:12:1826044010:1.text: Otherwise... she might decide to raze the entire theater to the ground in a fit of rage.
say:12:1826044010:1.source_cn: 否则一旦惹怒了她，说不准……连海歌剧院都会被她夷为平地。

say:13:1826044011:1.text: ... Her Ladyship would do no such thing.

say:14:1826044012:1.text: Of course. I was only joking.

say:15:1826044013:1.text: I hope you won't dismiss my words as mere scaremongering, Miss Senea. Thank you for your time.
say:15:1826044013:1.source_cn: 塞涅小姐，还请不要误会我是在危言耸听。打搅了。

narration:17:1826044015:1.text: Tres recounts everything Salazer said and did.
narration:17:1826044015:1.male: Tres recounts everything Salazer said and did.
narration:17:1826044015:1.female: Tres recounts everything Salazer said and did.
